title: Zambales Beauty cashew: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaTitle: Zambales Beauty cashew: Fruit and Tree Characteristics
metaDescription: Zambales Beauty cashew is a cashew variety from RMTU. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Zambales Beauty is a registered cashew variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2001 as NSIC 2001 Cs 04. RMTU bred it. Its record notes a yield of 552 fruits.

heroImage.alt: Young fruit trees planted in straight rows on cleared red soil, the kind of farm where Zambales Beauty cashew is grown

blocks.text: The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [cashew variety finder](/crop-varieties/cashew), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for fruit trees](/land-preparation/fruit-tree-land-preparation).
Key facts about Zambales Beauty cashew
When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. The mother tree of Zambales Beauty was about 12 years old and about 5.2 meters tall when it was registered. Its record notes a yield of 552 fruits. It bears every year, with fruit in March April. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cashew fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [mealybug](/pests/mealybug), [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its sweetness measured 14.75 degrees Brix, the share of sugar in the juice. Most table fruit tastes sweet from about 12 Brix up. The registry notes its fruiting season as March April, bearing annual.
Where and when to plant Zambales Beauty cashew

Kasoy stands drought and poor soil, which is why Palawan grows so much of it. Pick a selection by nut weight and shelling recovery, which decide the kernel you sell. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items: Buy grafted or budded plants from an accredited nursery, with the variety name on the tag.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Plant a few trees first if the variety is new to your area, before you fill the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.a: The record shows a recorded yield of 552 fruits. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy planting material of Zambales Beauty?
items.a: Buy grafted, budded or marcotted trees from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, so you get the true variety. Ask your provincial agriculture office for the nearest one.
